routes.title: 辣公鸡或新化风味分享餐
routes.route: 吉星南路其其辣公鸡与丽春路对味牛肚王作为娄底市区正餐二选一。后者主打新化风味，但不能因此导航到新化县；先核对丽春路具体分店，三合汤和鸡肉份量按人数点。

en.title: Spicy chicken or Xinhua-style shared meal
en.route: Choose Qiqi chicken on Jixing South Road or Duiwei on Lichun Road for one city meal. Duiwei serves Xinhua-style food, which does not place this branch in Xinhua County. Check the Lichun Road branch and size soup or chicken portions for your group.

routes.title: 凤凰米粉、泡菜与湘西土菜
routes.route: 早餐可在虹桥中路十里香选米粉，古城游逛时按食量选择东正街方向婆婆泡菜，正餐再选南华路田园本味。按三餐与加餐分开，不因整条加入就全部计费；确认古城步行入口和分店营业。

en.title: Fenghuang noodles, pickles and local dishes
en.route: Consider Shilixiang noodles on Hongqiao Middle Road for breakfast, optional Popo pickles toward Dongzheng Street during the old-town visit, and Tianyuan on Nanhua Road for a main meal. Keep meals and snacks separate; importing the outline does not enable every cost. Check pedestrian access and branch operation.
